name: OMAN CERAMIC (Under Liquidation ) SAOG
description: Oman Ceramic Company SAOG is currently Under Liquidation on the MSX Under_Monitoring Market following Extraordinary General Meeting resolutions passed in May 2023, and carries zero active market capitalization. Originally founded in September 1999 and listed in January 2002 at Sohar Industrial Estate (OMR 1.89 million paid-up capital across 1.89 million shares and 125 registered shareholders, including the Social Protection Fund), the company historically manufactured ceramic sanitaryware and building-material products in Oman. Commercial manufacturing operations have ceased as the company progresses through formal legal liquidation and asset wind-down.
